about.headline: Engineering and software development in one skill set.
paragraphs: I am a mechanical design engineer with hands-on manufacturing experience and a Python backend developer. I combine engineering thinking with software development — from product design and production tasks to APIs, databases and automation.
I have worked with metal structures, sheet metal, drawings and design documentation. In software, I take services from backend code and tests through Docker, CI/CD and VPS deployment.

experience.title: Design and manufacturing
experience.description: 4 years 6 months of hands-on manufacturing experience — from Design Engineer to Head of the Design Department.

avalon.summary: Led the design department, designed metal structures and owned documentation quality, manufacturing coordination and product launch.
responsibilities: Managed the design department and organized the work of design engineers and process engineers.
Designed metal structures.
Optimized product designs, unified parts, and reduced manufacturing cost.
Organized collaboration between the design department, production, quality control (OTK), and the procurement department.
Developed and implemented measures to reduce defects and production errors.
Controlled preparation of design documentation and supported product launch into production.
Introduced design standards and improved the quality of released documentation.
Worked in SolidWorks.
Solved non-standard technical problems and modernized existing products and production processes.
Controlled project deadlines and ensured timely release of design documentation.

intecron.summary: Designed steel doors, prepared drawings and technical documentation, supported manufacturing and managed custom projects.
responsibilities: Designed steel doors.
Prepared drawings and technical documentation.
Supported the production process.
Introduced design improvements.
Controlled the quality of finished products.
Participated in complex custom projects.
Managed projects related to steel door manufacturing.

spas.summary: Designed and calculated metal door structures, supported manufacturing and updated projects based on testing results.
responsibilities: Developed design and technical documentation.
Designed and calculated metal door structures.
Supported the manufacturing process.
Made project changes based on testing and operation results.
Controlled the quality of manufactured products.

kontakt.summary: Developed and refined structures and drawings in Solid Edge, including sheet metal work.
responsibilities: Worked in Solid Edge with drawings, refined designs, and developed constructions. Worked with sheet metal.

Worked with sheet metal (steel doors) and various products, and also built different assemblies with internal mechanisms

door-soft.title: Door Soft Platform
door-soft.summary: A system for automating engineering calculations and production preparation for metal doors.
door-soft.task: Automate engineering calculations and manufacturing workflows for metal door production.
door-soft.solution: Combined manufacturing expertise with software development: built a Python backend, over 150 REST API endpoints, an engineering calculator and data preparation for sheet metal nesting.
door-soft.result: A working production platform deployed to a VPS in Docker with Nginx, a custom domain and HTTPS.

goodpapa.title: Dobry Papa — Furniture Studio Digital Platform
goodpapa.summary: A commercial platform for showcasing work and managing a furniture studio's content.
goodpapa.task: Bring the public catalog, media, contacts and content management into one digital product.
goodpapa.solution: Built a responsive website, secure admin panel and Telegram Mini App; configured Supabase, authentication, RLS and Cloudflare R2.
goodpapa.result: A unified commercial platform with project catalog, photo gallery, video library, audit trail and analytics.

door-sandbox.title: Door Calculation Sandbox

door-sandbox.solution: Prepared a separate backend environment with REST APIs, PostgreSQL and Docker for iterative development and testing.
door-sandbox.result: Changes can be validated in isolation without affecting the production environment.
